title: Technology Innovation in Indigenous Education
description: Explores both traditional and modern technologies in education privileging Indigenous contexts and classrooms. Students design and develop learning experiences intended to improve learning, enrich professional practice and provide positive models for students, colleagues and communities.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IED 336, ED-B 359, ED-B 360, EDCI 336, EDCI 406, EDUC 406.
